name: formwork
description: Fill any job application from your own profile, with every answer reviewable before you submit.
author: Jeremiah Mackey
//type: Deliberately NOT "module": the extension's .js files are classic scripts (UMD) that tests and tools load with require(). Test files use .mjs, so they are ES modules regardless.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:py && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fast: node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/integration/*.test.mjs && npm run test:py
